[OUR AIM]{.eyebrow}

## From waste to new [possibilities]{style="color: green;"}

Our overall research aims is to study, implement, and evaluate the ***upcycling potential*** of mixed plastic waste via in-situ reactive compatibilization using **open-source additive manufacturing**.

[OUR APPRAOCH]{.eyebrow}

## Multi-level perspective of the [Distributed Upcycling]{fg="orange"}

Our overall research aims is to study, implement, and evaluate the ***upcycling potential*** of mixed plastic waste via in-situ reactive compatibilization using **open-source additive manufacturing**.

UP3DCYCLING project is supported by multidisciplinary expertise spanning three domains: 1) polymer science, 2) additive manufacturing processes, and 3) socio-technical systems.
The interaction across these three levels is supported by experimental, modeling, and scenario approaches, which constitute a key added value of the project, enabling a holistic understanding of both technical and social dynamics.


:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-5 }
